preliminary_reasons: The report was requested as preliminary.
17 discovered cases are incomplete, unavailable or invalid.

study_metadata.study: Tello-sized synchronized tilted actuator spacing refinement

estimated_power.formula: rated battery energy Wh / (maximum endurance minutes / 60)
estimated_power.status: Inference from rated energy and forward-flight endurance; not a measured hover, peak, motor or shaft power. Usable energy during the published test is unspecified.

study_metadata.loss_model_formula: shaft_W = motor_conversion * (esc_efficiency * (battery_W - auxiliary_W) - rotors * idle_W_per_motor); axial_W = axial_fraction * shaft_W
study_metadata.loss_model_status: Explicit assumptions retained from the earlier study; no efficiencies were fitted to Tello mass, endurance or thrust.

aircraft_mass_assumption.status: Hypothetical identical 80 g total mass for both layouts: no added motor, propeller, frame or synchronizer mass. Guarded 87 g reference is reported separately.

study_metadata.geometry_status: Default diameter is exactly 0.0762 m, the published 3-inch size. Geometry is a finite actuator cylinder, not stock Tello blade, frame, guard or fuselage CAD; no stock Tello motor calibration.
study_metadata.geometry_model: Four square corners; eight adds the four side midpoints. d is original-to-added neighboring center spacing; square side is 2*d. All centers lie at z=0.
study_metadata.tilt_convention: Positive points craft thrust up/out and forces air down/in; negative raises outer blade edges and spreads downwash outward.
study_metadata.synchronization_assumption: Blade contact is assumed avoided by synchronization; no explicit blades or phase-resolved blade passage are modeled.
study_metadata.averaging: Arithmetic time integration and convergence checks must use the per-case averaging_start_s and averaging_stop_s; no results are generated here.
limitations: Actuator-only reaction thrust; forces on frames, guards and fuselage are not modeled.
Electrical conversion and unresolved blade-loss factors are assumed, not measured.
The actuator model resolves shared flow interaction, not synchronized blade timing.

result_kind: Actual CFD gross vertical lift; assumed-loss inferred electrical/shaft powers; reference masses applied only in postprocessing
